marcia.text: The allotments passed another inspection. The minutes are available. The interesting part is not in the minutes.
Fourteen years as secretary and I still can't get anyone to read the agenda before the meeting.
Something is growing under plot 31 that I did not plant. I am being very calm about it.
Compost is a long game. So, as it turns out, is most of what I do.
Reminder that a hosepipe ban is a suggestion to people who don't know where the standpipe is.
Open to discreet horticulture. Discretion is the whole job.

tomasz.text: Looking for a role with room to grow. I have my own boots and most of a van.

variants.eager: Looking for ANY role with room to grow. Boots, van, 5am starts. Ask me anything. Ask me twice.

tomasz.text: Learned three new things before breakfast. Need more things.
First-class degree, zero references. Reference me, someone.
The van has a name now. It does not answer to it.
Ran the numbers on a seam today. Nobody asked. Ran them again.

bernie.text: Forty years. Three owners. I am still here and they are not.
Not here to learn. Here to be paid and left alone. Tea, two sugars.
A seam knows when it's being rushed. So do I.
Young people ask me for my secret. It is turning up.
Retired twice. Both times, someone rang.
No questions. That's the whole reference.

saoirse.text: Left the Collective on good terms. Mostly. Ask me about the awkward seam in Peckham, I have a lot to say about

variants.distracted: Left the Collective on good terms. Mostly. Ask me about the awkward seam in Peckham, which reminds me, did I ever tell you about Lisbon

saoirse.text: Six years growing for other people. Wondering what it's like to grow for a reason.
Good with the awkward ones. The seams, I mean. People are a separate skill.
Nearly went to Lisbon once. The ferry was lovely. I was not on it.

variants.distracted: Nearly went to Lisbon once. The ferry was lovely. Anyway what was I posting. Lisbon. The ferry.

saoirse.text: Co-operatives are just committees that remember each other's birthdays.
Mostly on good terms with everyone. That is a real sentence I wrote.

priya.text: Signed something once. Cannot discuss what. Can discuss the paperwork, which was immaculate.
Stress load tested a thing today. The thing held. The thing's origin did not come up.
Formerly of a firm. The firm is not on the list of places I have been.
Materials don't lie. Certificates do. I keep both.
Open to work that involves measuring things. Open to not asking what they are.

dot.text: Market stall, Deptford, Saturdays. Tinctures, poultices, no refunds on heartbreak.
My remedy for heartbreak is mostly gin. The rest is honesty about the gin.
Someone asked for a poultice for a haunted knee. Did it. Knee seems happy.
Saturdays only, unless you're paying. Which you should be.
Good to see the paperwork hold up. Mine never does.
Open to work. Bring your own jar.

gideon.text: Clerkenwell-trained. Invoices to the minute. The minute is not negotiable.
Opened a movement today that most people can't open. It was running backwards. I said nothing.
Expensive and worth it. In that order.
A clock that's right twice a day is still wrong. A clock that's wrong on purpose is a commission.
Guild apprentices learn patience first and tools second. The tools are the easy part.
Time, as ever, is billed separately.

ray.text: Jack of all trades. Ask around. Not all of them will say good things.

variants.distracted: Jack of all trades. Ask around. Not all of them will say good things. Where was I. Trades.

ray.text: Done a bit of everything. Some of it twice. The second time went better.

variants.distracted: Turns up. Usually. Today I turned up at the wrong depot but it was a nice depot.

ray.text: Fate, emotion, time. I dabble. Dabbling has a rate.
Reference available on request. Reference may be a different Ray.
Open to anything with a van. Or a bike. Or a very determined walk.

comments.text: Good to hear the paperwork held.
Tell me more when you can.
I know someone who can help with that.
Interesting. Don't put that in writing again.
That explains the noise last Tuesday.
Thanks for sharing. Please stop sharing.

{name} has moved on from {employer}. It was not a quiet exit.

{name} has cleared their desk. Reasons undisclosed, references available.

{name} is now at {employer}. The offer was not matched.
employed: {name} is now working for {employer}. Details to follow.
